name: claude-mind-manager
description: Region-based context management for Claude Code. 6 commands: /mind-claudemd (create/audit/optimize CLAUDE.md), /mind-memory (MEMORY.md management), /mind-rules (rules validation/creation), /mind-files (project setup per type), /mind-update (fast context sweep), /mind-session-log (chronological session transcripts from JSONL). v3.2: bugfix release (edit-vor-read crash fixed in 4 skills, MIND_BACKUP_DIR env-var, confirmation disambiguation) + new mind-session-log skill. 2 agents, 1 hook. Claude Code CLI only (not Desktop). Zero dependencies.
